items.html: And now we will explain the matter of the NRN (Nefesh, Ruach, Neshama) of the Nukva of ZA of Atzilut. For behold, there are ten Names of HaVaYaH, as is stated in the Tikkunim: HaVaYaH with the Kamatz [vocalization] in Keter, HaVaYaH with the Patach in Hochma, etc. And the tenth HaVaYaH, without vocalization, is in the Nukva of ZA of Atzilut; and this HaVaYaH is the Neshama of all these thirty.
